stages.name: promotion_playoff
stages.note: the two group runners-up play for one more promotion place

stages.name: relegation_playoff
stages.note: the two 9th-placed clubs play; the loser is relegated as well as both 10th-placed clubs

playoff.entries: runners-up of Group A and Group B
playoff.note: Group winners are promoted directly; the two runners-up meet for a third promotion place.
Three clubs go up to the Championship (two direct plus a play-off winner, as in 2025-26); the 2026-27 group draw was not published before the season started on 13 November 2026.

boundaries.note: The bottom three of the Super League go down and are placed into the Championship's two geographical groups. Up: both group winners plus the winner of the runners-up play-off.
Championship: both 10th-placed clubs are relegated and the two 9th-placed clubs play off for a third relegation. Liga Nusantara sends two clubs up plus a play-off winner.

conflicts.real: 24 clubs, group structure for 2026-27 not yet published
conflicts.note: 2024-25 used two groups of eight with a championship round and relegation play-offs; with 24 clubs the shape must differ. Recorded with null group count rather than a guess.

conflicts.real: no title play-off section in the 2026-27 season article; 2024-25 had a Championship Series
conflicts.note: The 2026-27 Super League appears to be a straight 34-round table, but the format has changed twice in three seasons, so treat 'no title play-off' as season-specific.

notes: Names changed in 2025: Liga 1 is now Super League, Liga 2 is Championship (Kejuaraan), Liga 3 is Liga Nusantara (since 2024). Four levels: Super League (professional), Championship (professional), Liga Nusantara (semi-professional), Liga 4 (amateur, 38 provincial leagues with a 64-club national phase - not in our rows). Championship is 20 clubs in two geographical groups of ten playing a triple round robin (27 games), with a runners-up promotion play-off and a 9th-place relegation play-off. Super League 2026-27 is 18 clubs; three came up (two direct, one through the promotion play-off) and three went down. Liga Nusantara 2026-27 has 24 clubs (15 retained, 3 down from the Championship, 6 up from Liga 4) and started on 13 November 2026.
